episode_summary: In this episode, Mengjiao Chen shares her journey as a first-year full-time real estate agent, focusing on her success with cold calling and the challenges of building effective follow-up systems. Michael Open provides coaching on overcoming avoidance and developing personalized systems that align with one's strengths. Listeners will gain insights into balancing work and personal life while building a sustainable real estate business.
